title: Incremental Vector Index Sync
signature: def sync_index(source_docs, manifest, store, embedder, max_delete_fraction=0.5)
hints: Compare sha256 content hashes to sort each doc into added, changed, unchanged or deleted. An unchanged doc costs nothing: no embedding call and no store call.

Derive chunk ids from content: doc_id, the first 12 hex digits of the paragraph's sha256, and an occurrence number for repeated paragraphs. Then inserting a paragraph at the top doesn't rename every chunk below it.
For a changed doc, embed and upsert only the ids that are new, and only then delete the ids that disappeared. Check the mass-delete guard before you touch anything.
